description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractIntegerDistribution' for integer-valued discrete probability distributions within the Apache Commons Math library. It provides implementations for common methods such as cumulative probability calculations, inverse cumulative probability, sampling, and utilities for reseeding, while leaving distribution-specific behaviors to subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractIntegerDistribution
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations for integer distribution methods in the Apache Commons Math library. It manages common functionality such as probability calculations, inverse CDF, sampling, and random seed reseeding, meant to be extended by concrete distribution classes.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a random variable falls within an interval [x0, x1], with default implementation using the difference of cumulative probabilities.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse CDF for a given probability p, using a combination of interval bracketing and bisection, with optional Chebyshev inequality optimization.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a specified number of samples by repeatedly calling the 'sample()' method.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Resets the underlying random number generator seed.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the probability mass function at a given point.
